HOME.BADGE: Chemistry teaching platform for secondary school students
HOME.DESC: Interact with molecules, learn chemistry concepts with AI tutoring, and test your knowledge — all in one modern platform.
HOME.FEATURES_TITLE: Everything you need to learn chemistry
HOME.FEATURES_DESC: Four powerful tools designed for interactive chemistry education
HOME.VIEWER_DESC: Explore molecular structures in full 3D. Rotate, zoom, and examine atoms and bonds of common molecules like H₂O, NH₃, CH₄, and more.
HOME.LESSONS_DESC: Structured lessons covering molecular geometry, chemical bonds, and more. Each lesson includes interactive 3D models.
HOME.TUTOR_DESC: Chat with an AI tutor that explains chemistry concepts clearly. Ask about molecular shapes, bonds, reactions, and more.
HOME.QUIZ_DESC: Multiple choice quizzes on various chemistry topics. Track your scores and improve your understanding.
HOME.BAND_DESC: Explore molecules in 3D, master reactions with AI-powered simulations, and track your progress.
